title: Chapter 315
text:
After sending everyone away, Han Xiao walked into the room alone and let out a long sigh. He finally had the chance to be alone. The first step of entering the galaxy was complete.

There were many possibilities in the galaxy, and there were many plans for his next move. He needed to decide on a route.

Firstly, he was located in the Garton Star System of the Colton Star Cluster. According to his strength, this area was dangerous but just right for him to develop. He was a LV 70 Mechanic, Grade C, and could be considered the backbone of the Supers in the Colton Star Cluster.

It could be seen that the universe was divided into many Star Fields, and the Colton Star Cluster belonged to the [Shattered Star Ring] Star Field. The Shattered Star Ring was located at the edge of the visible universe and was considered a remote place. Its name came from the structure of the star map. This Star Field was like a scattered broken star ring, and the various Star Clusters were part of this' ring '.

The ring surrounded the center of the Shattered Star Ring, which was a very dangerous place. There was an extremely large group of unstable wormholes, and all kinds of garbage would be thrown in from time to time from various Star Fields, forming a garbage dump. Because of this, scavengers were very active in the Shattered Star Ring.

There was a saying that was often used: 'Where there are people, there will be trouble.' There were many unorthodox jobs in the universe, such as space pirates, scavengers, mercenaries, colonists, and so on. The Shattered Star Ring did not have a strong ruling regime, only scattered Star Cluster and Star System level civilizations. Therefore, there were many unsafe areas.

The Shattered Star Ring was under the jurisdiction of 'Westsandlin' in name, but this civilization only sent emissaries to the office and rarely interfered. 'Westsandlin' was the official name of the Universal Civilization [Radiant Federation].

The bigger the area, the more dangerous it would be. Han Xiao remembered many opportunities, but based on the current situation, it was best to stay in the Colton Star Cluster and develop first. It was currently Version 1.0, and he did not know everything about the galactic storyline during this period. After all, logically speaking, the players should not have come into contact with the galaxy at this stage. However, some of the large-scale missions should not have changed.

The first step is to obtain information. Juberly Hub is a place where many organizations have offices. I can try to rely on one of them and obtain the initial information. Han Xiao thought to himself. As long as he got the information, he would be able to deduce some large-scale storyline quests that were suitable for him.

His core goal was naturally to grow. He was not limited by the version and was always ahead of the players. He had to maintain this advantage. Danger was everywhere, and if he did not advance, he would fall behind.

But now, Han Xiao's main class was stuck at the Class Advancement Quest. He needed to find a sub-class to level up to Level 80 and obtain enough Attribute Points to break through the 400 point threshold. He was not a casual person. Leveling up required more and more EXP, so he had to find a valuable and rare subclass. That was why he chose to change his class.

After the harvest from the Pro League, Han Xiao's EXP on his interface had reached 2,700,000,000. This would be his foundation for a very long time, so he didn't have to worry about running out of EXP in the short term. The accumulated resources and equipment were worth a few thousand to tens of thousands of Enas. The exact value would depend on the needs of the trading party and the fluctuating value of the machinery. It was impossible to estimate before the trade.

The other requirement for the Class Advancement was five Mechanic class Advancement Knowledges. In the universe, there were many ways to obtain Super knowledge. The higher-level knowledge was also restricted, but the Advancement Knowledges were not difficult to obtain. Some financial groups and organizations were selling Advancement Knowledges, and one could buy them as long as one had the money.

Earning money could solve this problem. As long as one had enough money, one could buy all the Advancement Knowledges. With money, one could really do whatever one wanted.

In terms of earning money, Han Xiao was not bragging. He was not afraid at all.

The players are equivalent to labor, and I can obtain Enas indirectly through them. Furthermore, they are also my helpers. If I were to become mercenaries, they would do missions while I collect money from behind. But if I want to earn a lot of money, it's best to sell rare items, such as mining some rare minerals … or do some missions that have existed for a long time …

The existence of the players was his advantage. If he used them well, he could get twice the result with half the effort. This was also the reason why he chose to bring the players along.

Growth and leveling up were his core goals. Han Xiao had another goal, which was to get ahead of the storyline and try to solve the Mutation Disaster of Blue Star in Version 2.0.

Speaking of the Mutation Disaster, one had to mention the evil faction of the Colton Star Cluster, Dark-star. In Version 2.0, many planets in the Shattered Star Ring were affected by the Mutation Disaster, and this organization was the cause. The novice planets in the other Star Fields experienced different storylines.

Dark-star was a reactionary organization that originated from the Godora Civilization, and Han Xiao was very clear about the history of Dark-star.

A large part of the origin of DarkStar came from the discrimination of Godora's pure-blooded members. Most of the members of DarkStar were mixed-blood Godorans, and due to the discrimination of their bloodlines, they developed extreme thoughts and constantly wanted to overthrow the Godoran regime. They believed that Godora was a rotten system, and they were the 'new Godora' of the new era.

Every civilization had their own ideology and traditions. Being advanced or backward was just based on different perspectives, and there was no absoluteness. Perhaps being tolerant was truly being advanced. Civilizations had their own specialties. Respecting the traditions of other civilizations and species, tolerating each other during negotiations, but not completely accepting each other. This was the norm for civilizations in the universe.

Of course, during the early stages of space exploration, there was no lack of civilizations with different ideologies, characteristics, and habits that could not be reconciled. For example, there was basically no possibility of communication between humans and species that ate humans. However, these extreme civilizations were either dead or injured, and as the super civilizations spread order, these species had no choice but to accept each other's existence.

Godora originated from magic, and before they came into contact with the universe, the Godora were all pure-blood. Only after they started to mate with other intelligent species were mixed blood Godora born. Thus, the pure-blood theory started to spread, and traditions were valued. Those in power were all pure-blood, and thus, the pure-blood and mixed-blood classes started to be separated. As Godora grew, more and more mixed-bloods were born, and the bloodline talent of the Godora was gradually diluted. Thus, more and more pure-bloods were valued, and the extreme pure-bloods did not even consider the mixed-bloods as the same race.

The conflict became more and more intense, and in the end, 'Dark-star' was born, going against Godora in every aspect.

If I want to solve the Mutation Disaster, I have to start with the Godora civilization …

Han Xiao thought to himself. The Mutation Virus had a very high latency, and in his previous life, it had only attracted attention when the Mutation Disaster actually happened. The only thing he could do now was to prepare for the worst.

These two goals were the main focus of his current plan. He thought about the details of the plan, turned on his communicator, and browsed through the galactic channel to understand the current situation of the Colton Star Cluster.

At this time, a notification came from the broadcast. "Everyone, please return to your rooms. The spaceship is about to accelerate and enter the Light Warp Path. There may be some turbulence, and if you feel dizzy, please do not panic. This is a normal reaction."

Rapid footsteps could be heard outside the door, and all the passengers returned to their rooms. Kerlodd and the players also returned. Black safety belts popped out from the wall. For such a low-level travel group, there was no need to hope for protective compartments.

After buckling up, the room door was automatically locked, and a roar could be heard from within the spaceship. The metal walls and floor trembled non-stop.

Immediately after, a pushing force pressed down on everyone and pressed them to their seats. This was the reaction force that had been weakened many times by various devices.

Short Horn Star spewed out a blazing tail flame, and its speed kept increasing.

Streaks of light suddenly appeared outside the dark window, as if they had entered a tunnel of light.

Buzz!

Just as the pushing force reached its peak, Short Horn Star suddenly flashed and turned into a beam of light.

The engine was running at full power, and they entered the warp path. Under the effect of the internal stabilizing device, the reaction force was quickly reduced, and everyone's bodies relaxed.

"Next stop, Star Zone 5 of the Garton Star System. Travel time is three days. Please enjoy the journey."

…

For three consecutive days, Han Xiao remained low-key on the spaceship. The players, on the other hand, were very friendly. They talked to the passengers and helped them enthusiastically. This was the first time that this group of passengers had seen such friendly humans. After chatting with them, they could tell that the players had limited knowledge and were probably natives.

Kerlodd was drinking a dark blue wine at the bar. At this time, a mixed-blood human with pointy ears and thin cheeks walked up to him and threw an Enas coin to show that the drink was on him. He smiled and said, "You got on the spaceship from Blue Star? That low-level planet only has a low-level civilization, and the people you brought on the spaceship are all natives? "

"What does that have to do with you?" Kerlodd glanced at him.

"Hehe, are you interested in doing business with me? My name is Cesoly, and I'm in this business … "This person was wearing gloves, and he quietly opened a gap to reveal the tattoo on the back of his hand. The tattoo was a bird wrapped around a chain. This was the symbol of a slave trader, and it could be considered as a scavenger business.

Kerlodd waved his hand impatiently and said, "F * ck off, I'm too lazy to talk to you."

Public spaceships were a mix of good and bad people, and there were many gray organizations that were looking for fat sheep. Therefore, those who could afford it did not want to take the Galactic Travel Agency. Kerlodd hated coming into contact with scavengers, as it ruined his mood. He was not even in the mood to drink his favorite Dark Blue Star Bubble.

"Don't be in such a hurry to reject. I can see that the natives you brought are all Supers. The market price for Supers is pretty good. Why don't you consider it?" Cesoly said patiently.

At this time, Han Xiao's voice sounded behind the two of them.

"I think you should leave."
